name: Get All Leads
description: Get all leads from Pipedrive. [See the documentation](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/Leads#getLeads)

configurable_props.name: maxResults
configurable_props.label: Max Results
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of results to return. If not provided, all leads will be returned.

configurable_props.name: ownerId
configurable_props.label: Owner ID
configurable_props.description: If supplied, only leads matching the given user will be returned. However, **Filter ID** takes precedence over **Owner ID** when supplied.

configurable_props.name: personId
configurable_props.label: Person ID
configurable_props.description: If supplied, only leads matching the given person will be returned. However, **Filter ID** takes precedence over **Person ID** when supplied.

configurable_props.name: organizationId
configurable_props.label: Organization ID
configurable_props.description: If supplied, only leads matching the given organization will be returned. However, **Filter ID** takes precedence over **Organization ID** when supplied.

configurable_props.name: filterId
configurable_props.label: Lead Filter ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the filter to use. Takes precedence over **Owner ID**, **Person ID**, and **Organization ID** when supplied.

configurable_props.name: sort
configurable_props.label: Sort
configurable_props.description: The field names and sorting mode separated by a comma (`field_name_1 ASC, field_name_2 DESC`). Only first-level field keys are supported (no nested keys). Valid fields: `id, title, owner_id, creator_id, was_seen, expected_close_date, next_activity_id, add_time, update_time`
